note: EN->KO renderings this product commits to. `derived` is not a translation opinion: those are the strings the interface itself already shows, so prose that says otherwise contradicts the screen beside it. `authored` IS an opinion — ours, written down so it can be argued with, like DOMAIN_FAMILIES in taxonomy.py. No external benchmark grades these; the machine-checkable part of a translation is the figures, not the word choice. Only the labels that also appear in answer prose are listed; the rest of the interface's string table is button chrome a translator never meets.
